surprises.head: A big night for Adin Hill
surprises.body: Hill allowed 1 goal on 29 shots, worth 3.8 expected goals: 2.8 fewer than expected. Starting goalies have a night this good about once every 45 starts.

story.head: Hill stands on his head
paras: Mitch Marner got the scoring started for the Golden Knights shorthanded midway through the second, and Jack Eichel pushed the lead to 2-0 a minute and a half later. Beck Malenstyn pulled the Sabres within one early in the third, but that was as close as they got. Tomáš Hertl scored later in the period and again a little over four minutes later to make it 4-1, and the Sabres never had an answer.

Don’t let the score fool you: the chances were a lot closer than that. Adin Hill made 28 saves for the Golden Knights, and Colten Ellis stopped 22 of 26 at the other end. The Knights improved to 12-5-2, second in the Pacific, while the Sabres fell to 8-6-3, sixth in the Atlantic.
